summary_en: Ship Healthcare Holdings, the parent company of a related entity and indirect holder of 29.33% of shares, launched a tender offer for all outstanding shares at 1,970 yen per share and stock options at 1 yen each, with a 30-business-day period from November 9 to December 21, 2026. The board endorsed the offer and recommended shareholder participation, with the aim of acquiring full ownership and delisting the company.
title_en: Notice of Opinion in Support of and Recommendation to Participate in Tender Offer for Our Common Shares and Stock Options by Ship Healthcare Holdings Corporation, Parent Company of Other Related Companies
translation_en_brief:
Ship Healthcare Holdings Corporation, which is the parent company of a related entity and indirectly holds 9,600,000 shares (29.33% of outstanding shares) through its wholly owned subsidiary S.T.K., announced a tender offer for all common shares and stock options of Charm Care Corporation. The offer price is 1,970 yen per common share and 1 yen per stock option (covering four series of employee stock options issued between 2017 and 2020). The tender offer period runs for 30 business days from November 9 to December 21, 2026.

The board of directors of Charm Care Corporation held a meeting on November 6, 2026, and resolved to express support for the tender offer and recommend that shareholders participate. The board also stated that warrant holders may decide independently whether to participate. One of the company's seven directors is a non-executive director appointed by Ship Healthcare Holdings. The two companies have had a business partnership agreement since May 2020 and conduct transactions in food service outsourcing and consumables procurement.

The tender offer is intended to result in Ship Healthcare Holdings acquiring full ownership of Charm Care Corporation and delisting the company from the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market, where it is currently listed under code 6062.
